samples.question: The square sheet is ruled into 8 by 8 cells, and the two dashed lines are creases. Fold the sheet in half along the vertical crease, then in half along the horizontal crease, so all four quarters lie exactly on top of one another. The black squares are holes punched straight through the whole folded stack, so every quarter ends up holed. Now open the sheet flat again. Exactly one of the four colored dots sits on a hole of the opened sheet. Which dot? Answer blue, green, red, or yellow.
